! Game text
| Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▼ spy Artoo ({{Errata hl|1=deploy -2}}). During your control phase, if Artoo at same site as a captive Leia, use 1 Force to release her ({{Errata hl|1=you retrieve no Force this turn}}). While Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself on table, Battle Order is suspended where Leia is present. ({{Errata hl|1=Immune to This Is Some Rescue.}}) [Immune to Alter] || Deploy on table. Once per game, may ▼ spy R2-D2 ({{Errata hl|1=for free}}). During your control phase, if R2-D2 is with captive Leia, may use 1 Force to release her. While Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself on table, where Leia present, ignore Battle Order. {{Errata hl|1=May not be canceled.}} [Immune to Alter]
